synopsis: GAO's Schedule Assessment Guide (GAO-16-89G, December 2015) defines ten best-practice areas for a reliable integrated schedule [f9627, f16433]. These include capturing all activities, sequencing them with logic, resourcing activities, and performing schedule-risk analysis, which Chapter 12 explicitly identifies as best practice [f16433, f9628]. The booklet uses the guide to support requiring reference classes, range assumptions, an S-curve, a critical path, buffers and long-lead items in the plan's “schedule and basis of estimate” section [f16438]. The companion cost publication is GAO's Cost Estimating and Assessment Guide (GAO-20-195G), dated March 2020 in the glossary [f9629, f16434].

relations.note: Both identify the December 2015 guide and its ten integrated-schedule best-practice areas.
Both identify schedule-risk analysis as a best practice.
Both identify GAO-20-195G as the cost companion; the glossary specifies March 2020.
The integrated-schedule best practices underpin the booklet's scheduling requirements.
Schedule-risk analysis supports including uncertainty ranges and buffers in the plan.
